### AI Job Agent — Error Handler
Reusable execution-level failure handler — attach any AI Job Agent scheduled/unattended workflow to this one via its own Settings → Error Workflow (a manual, per-workflow n8n UI step; the SDK/MCP cannot set it — see this file's own header). Fires once per genuinely FAILED execution (a crashed node), never for expected per-source data outcomes (429/403/5xx/no-URL/etc. are handled as data inside the source workflows themselves and never reach here). Does NOT detect a schedule that never fired at all — no execution exists for this trigger to catch in that case; that is a separate, later, always-on-hosting-phase concern. Normalize Error Event → Build Alert Message → Notification Boundary (a placeholder — no channel wired yet, pending an explicit, approved credential).
